quest.5130117DD8F75308.quest_desc: The Rotor Shaft defines the turbine axis. Arrange shaft, blades and bearing as one valid assembly and place induction coils according to the guide. The controller then completes the kit.
quest.5130117DD8F75308.title: Shaft before blades
quest.51301182A048FC8B.quest_desc: The smallest reviewed layout with separate blade and coil layers is an asymmetric 3×4×4 shell (X×Y×Z). Its 44 shell blocks are 39 Casings, a Controller, a Rotor Bearing, two Fluid Ports and an FE Power Tap.

From the lower corner (0,0,0), place the Bearing at (1,3,1) facing down. Put Shafts at (1,2,1) and (1,1,1), one Blade at (1,2,2), and the iron-block coil at (1,1,2). Keep a Casing at (1,0,1). The blade and coil occupy separate levels along the shaft.

Put the controller and ports on other faces without replacing frame edges. One Fluid Port accepts steam; the other returns water. Engage the coil in the controller and supply a small steam flow. This compact rig introduces generation; expand it for industrial throughput.
The quest verifies the full kit. Check formation and an increasing FE counter in the controller after assembly.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
quest.51301182A048FC8B.title: Extreme Reactors Turbine: Complete Kit
quest.513011862E2A45CA.quest_desc: Fuel Rods form the internal fuel columns. Arrange them according to the reactor design and prepare a Control Rod for each required column. JEI shows the recipe's supported material alternatives.

quest.513011862E2A45CA.title: Fuel columns inside the casing
quest.5130118ED1242B42.quest_desc: A Control Rod controls its fuel column. Before startup, check that the components form a valid structure, reactor controls are available, and the fuel port has supply and extraction paths.

quest.51301193487DECA3.quest_desc: The Turbine Casing uses Cyanite from the reactor route and forms a separate steam-powered structure. Its recipe does not require a Reinforced Reactor: prepare a compatible steam source, rotor, bearing and induction coils using the native guide. Item quests do not enumerate every block for every possible size.

quest.513011AB19DDDE4C.quest_desc: Minimum 3×3×3 reactor: 22 Casings, a Controller, Fuel Rod, Control Rod, Solid Access Port and Active FE Power Tap. Put the Fuel Rod in the only interior block and the Control Rod in the roof above it.
This layout produces FE directly. Load fuel through the Access Port and switch that same port to extract waste when needed. Glass can optionally replace casing on the faces.
Open the controller after assembly to check formation. These inventory tasks alone do not verify a valid or operating reactor.
